description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a forest clearing floor among fallen trees at the edge of an old forest: trampled grass and dark soil, broken branches and twigs, scattered pine needles, a few dry leaves and small stones, muted dark palette of moss green, brown and grey, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
